The '''Stonefish''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in [[The Mines]] on the 20th floor during all seasons. The only other fish that can be caught on the 20th floor of the mines is the [[Ghostfish]]. 

The chances of hooking a Stonefish depends on fishing level and on the distance from land of the spot fished, increasing by 5% if a [[Curiosity Lure]] is equipped and by 10% if [[Targeted Bait|Stonefish Bait]] is equipped. For example, at level 10 fishing and distance of 5, the chances of hooking a Stonefish is 7.5%. This increases to 12.5% with a Curiosity Lure equipped, to 17.5% with Stonefish Bait equipped, and to 22.5% with both a Curiosity Lure and Stonefish Bait equipped.<ref name="mineshaft" />

The Stonefish and the [[Octopus]] are the only [[Fish#Fishing Pole Fish|fish caught with a fishing rod]] that cannot be eaten unless used in a [[Cooking#Recipes|recipe]].

==Tailoring==
Stonefish can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Fishing Hat|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Stonefish can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 5 days. The initial pond capacity is 1 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing four quests. The primary output is dark brown Stonefish [[Roe]], but [[Copper Ore]] is possible starting at population 3 and several more valuable items are possible starting at population 9.

==References==
<references>
    <ref name="mineshaft">See <samp>MineShaft::getFish</samp> in the game code. While <samp>Data\Fish.xnb</samp> suggests that a fishing level of 3 is needed to hook a Stonefish, the data in <samp>MineShaft::getFish</samp>, which does not have any level conditions, overrides it. This means that there is no fishing level requirement to hook a Stonefish.</ref>
</references>
